chapter.title: Signal Flow & Gain
chapter.sub: Green at the source. Clean all the way home.

items.alt: Soundcheck on stage: two microphones on stands, the digital console glowing, Maya waiting at the desk.
The meters light up red from the preamp onward — the signal is clipping. 'CRRK!' Maya jumps back from the console.

bubbles.text: It's clipping — I barely touched the fader!

items.alt: Ray points to the meters: every stage now sits in the green, from the microphone to the fader.

bubbles.text: Gain first, always. Keep every stage green before your fingers touch anything else.
Green at the source. Clean all the way home.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Signal moves: capture, process, route, reproduce. Fix problems at the earliest stage you can reach.
